qa_pairs.question: What section of the service manual does this rear axle layout drawing belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: This drawing belongs to Section 33-0, which covers the rear axle layout drawing for the 15° axle.

qa_pairs.question: What type of rear axle configuration is shown in this diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: This diagram shows a 15° axle configuration as indicated in the title.

qa_pairs.question: What is the diagram number shown at the bottom right of this page?
What suspension components are visible in the rear axle assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The diagram shows coil springs and shock absorbers (struts) as part of the rear suspension system.

qa_pairs.question: How is the differential positioned in relation to the axle assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The differential is centrally mounted in the rear axle assembly, with drive shafts extending to both rear wheels.

qa_pairs.question: What braking components can be identified in this rear axle layout?
qa_pairs.answer: Brake discs and brake calipers are visible at each rear wheel position in the assembly.

qa_pairs.question: What connects the differential to the rear wheels in this assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Drive shafts (halfshafts) connect the differential to each rear wheel, transmitting power from the differential to the wheels.

qa_pairs.question: What type of drawing is this rear axle illustration?
qa_pairs.answer: This is a rear axle layout drawing, which is an exploded view showing the spatial relationship and assembly of all rear axle components.
